Notion is a productivity and note-taking application developed by Notion Labs, Inc. It serves as a workspace for notetaking, knowledge management, data organization, and project and task tracking. It was first released in 2016 and is available on the web and as desktop and mobile apps. The company is headquartered in San Francisco.
